falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes above 4,800 with volume exceeding 120% of 20-day average volume
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A decisive breakout on expanding volume would invalidate the 76% pattern match to the 2020 December consolidation, as that pattern resolved with a continuation breakout rather than reversal; this would prove the 'transition' pattern was misidentified and the current signal should have been BULLISH not HOLD

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 25 for 3 consecutive trading days while S&P 500 remains above its 50-day moving average
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This divergence—elevated fear without price breakdown—would invalidate the BLOWOFF SCORE of 51 (moderate complacency zone), proving the score understated risk and the HOLD signal was inappropriate; a true blowoff/transition pattern requires VIX suppression or spike with price weakness, not sustained elevated fear with flat prices

falsification_conditions.condition: 10-year Treasury yield drops below 3.80% AND DXY (U.S. Dollar Index) drops below 103.00 simultaneously for 2+ consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This dual breakdown would invalidate the macro transition thesis entirely, as the 2020 December breakout pattern occurred in a reflationary environment with rising yields and falling dollar; simultaneous yield and dollar collapse would prove the current macro regime is deflationary/disinflationary, making the pattern match spurious and the HOLD verdict wrong—should have been BEARISH risk-off

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
